# Next.js Starter Repository

> Production-grade Next.js 16 starter repository built with the App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, ESLint 9 Flat Config, and Husky automation.

## Tech Stack & Tooling

- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router, React 19)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 (`@tailwindcss/postcss`, `@theme` directive, `next/font`)
- **Validation**: `@t3-oss/env-nextjs` + Zod runtime environment checks
- **Logging**: winston structured logger with recursive secret redaction
- **Linting & Formatting**: ESLint v9 Flat Config, Prettier
- **Testing**: Vitest (unit tests in `tests/`)
- **Git Hygiene**: Husky v9, `lint-staged`, Commitlint (Conventional Commits), branch-name and push-guard scripts
- **CI**: GitHub Actions (typecheck, lint, test, build)
- **Theme Management**: `next-themes` with hydration protection

## Key Conventions

- App Router layout in `app/` (layout, page, loading, error, not-found, global-error, robots, sitemap)
- Server-only code under `lib/`, validated env in `lib/env.ts`, canonical URL in `lib/app-url.ts`
- Security headers configured in `next.config.ts` (CSP, HSTS prod-only, COOP, CORP)
- Engineered git hooks: branch naming, conventional commits, protected-branch push guard, per-commit typecheck
